correctness.rationale: Exact convex-hull vertical-section criterion, explicit distribution identities for extreme-span and nearest-gap obstructions, and disjoint partition prove the all-m integrals. Exact integration gives the small sample formulas. Endpoint Watson and interior Laplace expansions give both leading constants and critical sqrt(m) dominance. Limits are fixed c; no computation is used to infer an infinite theorem. 46,440 exact-rational finite cases and numerical integral checks independently corroborated definitions and formulas.

value.rationale: The first polynomial degree beyond affine moments yields a natural full sample-size reliability problem, with variance as a nonarbitrary parameter. The exact finite probabilities and sharp asymptotic prefactors classify both failure mechanisms and a genuine critical crossover at 3−2√2. For the equal target/sampling uniform example, \(P_3=(\log3-2/3)/2\) and \(F_m\sim3(2/3)^m\) provide actionable algorithm benchmarks, beyond routine positivity observations.
